title:
Epic to handle redirection to Model Setup Page based on the following rules:

- If {@link ReliabilityUIConfig#showModelSetupWithSensorAssociationUIFlows} and {@link ReliabilityAsset#targetTag}
  exist it will redirect to Model Setup With Correlation page for the given asset.
- Otherwise it redirects to Model Setup page for the given asset.

**Notes**:
- This epic doesn't expect any payload, but expects `id` {@link UiSdlPageParam} to exists.
name: AssetDetailsCreateModelRedirectEpic
